The '''Republic assault on Virujansi''' was a confrontation that took place in [[17,018 BBY]] on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Virujansi">{{CSWECite|III|308|Virujansi}}</ref> [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. It became one of the earliest battles of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long series of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies. The latter included the [[Grand Companies]], which were Coruscant-backed [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] conglomerates based along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as [[the Spin]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The assault on Virujansi, which was situated in the [[Exploitation Region|region]] actively controlled by the Grand Companies and along one of the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes that were either contested or neutral in the conflict, by the Coruscant-controlled [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] constituted a part of the [[First Alsakan Conflict|first]] of the Alsakan Conflicts, which began around the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. [[17,012 BBY|Six years later]], Alsakani forces [[Alsakani liberation of Virujansi|liberated]] the planet, and the First Conflict lasted for [[16,700 BBY|three more]] [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic assault on Virujansi was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
